text:
Grace L: Hey finance, I paid for a post-conference team dinner on my personal card. Card charge is 2512.50 EUR (converted on my statement). Restaurant only gave a single card slip with total, no itemized food/drink lines or VAT number. Need to split 50/50 Eng/Partnerships. What do you need to reimburse?
Evan M: I approve the 50/50 split and confirm attendees were Grace L, Tom H, Lina W, and Rafael P. Business purpose: post-conference client follow-ups.
Samir R: Thanks. For VAT reclaim we need either an itemized invoice showing VAT and the restaurant's tax reg number, or an emailed PDF invoice. If the vendor can't provide VAT number we can still reimburse but VAT will be non-reclaimable.
Grace L: Vendor said their POS system doesn't print VAT numbers on receipts but they can email a stamped invoice in 3-5 days. I need funds before my statement posts in 2 days  can we do interim reimbursement?
Finance Bot: Policy: expenses > 200 require an invoice with vendor tax registration for VAT reclaim. Interim reimbursements are allowed with manager approval; VAT will be marked non-reclaimable until compliant docs arrive.
Samir R: Since Evan approved, we can process an interim reimbursement. Please upload the card posting screenshot, the pictorial receipt, and Evan's approval into Concur. Use GL codes: 6302-ENG-EVENT (50%) and 6408-PARTNERSHIPS-EVENT (50%), and add note "interim - awaiting vendor invoice".
Grace L: Uploaded everything to Concur and marked the split. I also added vendor reply thread asking for PDF invoice.
AP Team Bot: Expedited reimbursements are available for card-close timing with manager approval. Grace, mark "expedite" in Concur notes and CC ap@redwood.com. Expected interim payout in 48 hours after documents confirmed.
Evan M: Marked expedite and CC'ed AP.
Samir R: One more note on tip: if tip was included on the receipt we reimburse it but if it was cash tip not on receipt we do not reimburse without a receipt. Please confirm whether service charge included on the slip.
Grace L: The slip shows total only; vendor says 12% service included. I asked them to confirm in their emailed invoice.
Finance Bot: If the emailed invoice arrives with VAT reg number and line items, finance will reclaim VAT and reverse the non-reclaimable VAT classification. Keep the email thread attached to the Concur item.
AP Team Bot: We have the Concur submission and expedite flag. Interim reimbursement queued; payout expected in 2 business days. Please update the same Concur record with the vendor invoice when received so we can reconcile.
Grace L: Thanks all  will post update when invoice arrives.
